selection_method: Source-verified first-appearance Temporal Grounding subset: six saved-baseline errors and six correct controls per split. The tranche is one error and one control per split.

arms.T0: frozen legacy 16-frame selection from saved baseline
arms.T1R: reviewed numeric window, including user-directed [0, first-sample] clip-boundary windows for targets present in the opening sample

annotation_contract.blank_unreviewed_boundaries: window_start_s and window_end_s store the reviewed visibility bracket and stay null until review_status and boundary_status are reviewed and identity_status is confirmed
annotation_contract.onset_censoring: For this run, the user directed that a target visible in the opening sample receive [0, first nonzero sampled timestamp], interpreted as first observation within this clip rather than its physical onset before the clip.
annotation_contract.opening_sample_interpretation: Use reviewed [0, first-sample] windows when the queried target is already visible at clip time 0. This changes the estimand to first observation within the clip and does not claim the target entered at time 0.
annotation_contract.t1r_window_policy: Recenter each valid saved T1 candidate window on the reviewed bracket midpoint while preserving its duration, clamped to clip bounds. If a saved candidate is missing or invalid, use the shortest local window of max(reviewed-bracket width, seven frames) centered on the reviewed bracket. --run preflights recenterability before model loading and requires at least 20/24 for the full set.
